tasks.spec:
You are a build worker writing a defect-reproduction script. OFFLINE while building: no network calls, no git, no MCP, no skills; write only in your working directory. The script will be EXECUTED LATER by a separate runner task with credentials in env.

INCIDENT: On 2026-08-03 ~20:58Z, Bland SMS conversation 782f4dce-5e90-446f-a886-c000f1c240b7 contained a patient correction 'No the following Thursday' after the agent had offered this-week Thursday 08/06/2026 times. The deployed Mott booking gateway's raw-text authority logged: raw_fetch msgs=11 -> raw_resolve from=08/06/2026 -> date_source=raw. The pathway's own extraction correctly held 'thursday next week'. The correct target was 08/13/2026; the raw authority silently won with 08/06/2026. Your script must reproduce that raw pipeline faithfully so a later analyst can localize the defect: LLM phrase-picking vs deterministic resolver vocabulary.

SOURCE MODULES (read and reuse; NEVER modify them): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-raw-text/work2/raw-text-authority-v2/bland_gateway_live.py matches the deployed log tags (raw_fetch msgs= near line 944, raw_resolve from= near 958, date_source=raw near 968; resolve_relative_date near 493). /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-llm-intent/work2/llm-intent-v2/bland_gateway.py is the LLM phrase-picking variant (llm_interpret_intent near lines 364-435; env ECP_LLM_MODEL_ID, deployed default us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 on Bedrock). First decide FROM THE CODE which module implements the raw path between raw_fetch and raw_resolve exactly as logged, and reuse THAT code path. Import the chosen module from its absolute path without triggering any web-server entrypoint (importlib + guards as needed).

WRITE ./repro.py with usage: repro.py <conversation_id>. Runtime env: BLAND_API_KEY (conversation fetch), FROZEN_NOW (ISO8601 with offset; monkeypatch or thread the module's notion of current time so resolution is deterministic), ambient AWS credentials for Bedrock if the raw path calls an LLM, ECP_LLM_MODEL_ID honored with the deployed default. Steps, each printing machine lines EXACTLY: (1) fetch the conversation messages via the module's own fetch path; write ./messages.json; print MSGS=<n>. (2) run the module's raw pipeline on those messages with time frozen; print PIPELINE_PICKED=<phrase|NONE|NOT-APPLICABLE> and PIPELINE_RESOLVED=<mm/dd/yyyy|NONE>. (3) isolation table: call resolve_relative_date directly (frozen time) on exactly these six inputs: thursday | the following thursday | following thursday | thursday next week | next thursday | thursday after next; print one STAGE2(<phrase>)=<mm/dd/yyyy|NONE> line per input. (4) if the raw path includes LLM phrase-picking, print LLM_PICKED=<phrase> from ONE real Bedrock call on the exact messages; otherwise print LLM_PICKED=NOT-APPLICABLE plus one line naming the function that picks the phrase. (5) print OBSERVED_DEPLOYED=08/06/2026 and CORRECT_TARGET=08/13/2026.

Rules: mask digit runs of 5 or more to last 4 in any printed or persisted message text; per-call HTTP timeout 120s; any fetch failure prints the failure and exits 1.

VERIFY before finishing: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile repro.py passes, and python3 repro.py with no args exits nonzero printing usage. Final message <=15 lines.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile repro.py || exit 1; if python3 repro.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'CHECK FAILED: no-args run must exit nonzero with usage'; exit 1; fi; echo 'repro.py compiles; usage guard works'
tasks.verified: A reproduction script that reuses the deployed raw-text-authority code path itself (fetch, phrase pick, resolve) with frozen time, emitting machine lines that localize the defect between LLM phrase-picking and resolver vocabulary.

tasks.spec: FROZEN_NOW=2026-08-03T16:58:00-04:00 python3 /home/ankit114/repos/paid_ads_mybcat/scripts/secret_exec.py --secret-env BLAND_API_KEY=mybcat/ai/api-keys/bland -- python3 -u /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT1/t1-repro-builder/repro.py 782f4dce-5e90-446f-a886-c000f1c240b7 > repro.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -8 repro.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -qE '^MSGS=[0-9]+' repro.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no MSGS line - conversation fetch failed'; tail -5 repro.txt; exit 1; }; grep -qE '^PIPELINE_RESOLVED=' repro.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no PIPELINE_RESOLVED line'; tail -5 repro.txt; exit 1; }; n=$(grep -cE '^STAGE2\(' repro.txt); [ "$n" -ge 6 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n STAGE2 lines, need 6"; exit 1; }; grep -q 'OBSERVED_DEPLOYED=08/06/2026' repro.txt || { echo 'FAIL: missing reference lines'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: repro complete; $(grep -m1 '^PIPELINE_RESOLVED=' repro.txt); $n stage2 rows"
tasks.verified: The deployed raw pipeline executed on the exact incident conversation with time frozen to the incident moment: picked phrase, resolved date, and a six-phrase resolver isolation table are all on the record.

tasks.spec:
You are a read-only research analyst. No git, no MCP, no skills, no network; write only report.md and eval_cases.json in your working directory; never modify any other file.

INCIDENT: patient texted 'No the following Thursday' (correcting an offer of this-week Thursday 08/06/2026); the deployed Mott gateway raw-text authority resolved 08/06/2026 (date_source=raw) and silently overrode the pathway's correct 'thursday next week' extraction; correct target 08/13/2026.

INPUTS (read): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT1/t1-repro-run/repro.txt (executed reproduction: MSGS=, PIPELINE_PICKED=, PIPELINE_RESOLVED=, six STAGE2() resolver-isolation lines, LLM_PICKED=); /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workT1/t1-repro-run/messages.json (the exact conversation, masked); /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-raw-text/work2/raw-text-authority-v2/bland_gateway_live.py (deployed-matching module; resolver vocabulary near lines 586-599); /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mott-llm-intent/work2/llm-intent-v2/bland_gateway.py (LLM phrase-picking variant, prompt near lines 365-385); /mnt/d_drive/repos/mott/gw-temporal-check/gen_golden.py (existing eval corpus generator - study its case style).

WRITE ./report.md with these sections: ROOT CAUSE containing exactly one line matching 'VERDICT: PHRASE-PICKING' or 'VERDICT: VOCABULARY' or 'VERDICT: BOTH' or 'VERDICT: NOT-REPRODUCED', plus one grounded paragraph; EVIDENCE quoting at least three literal lines from repro.txt including the PIPELINE_RESOLVED= line and at least one STAGE2( line; MECHANISM naming file and line of the exact code that mishandles 'the following thursday' (missing vocabulary pattern and/or phrase-pick defect) with line numbers you verified yourself; PROPOSED FIX describing the minimal change precisely (the pattern to add and where; the prompt change if stage 1 is implicated) WITHOUT editing any module; CVC PORTABILITY with 2-4 sentences on re-applying the fix to the CVC line later.

ALSO WRITE ./eval_cases.json: a JSON array of objects {"phrase": str, "context": "plain" or "correction-after-offer", "prior_offer": "MM/DD/YYYY" or null, "now": "YYYY-MM-DD", "expected": "MM/DD/YYYY"} with at least 10 NEW cases: the following-<weekday> family (following X, the following X, X after next, next X) across at least 3 different weekdays, plus at least 3 correction-after-offer cases where phrase is the corrective message sent after prior_offer. MUST include the incident itself: phrase 'No the following Thursday', context correction-after-offer, prior_offer 08/06/2026, now 2026-08-03, expected 08/13/2026. Every expected date must be arithmetically correct for its now - double-check each by hand.

Honesty rules: if repro.txt contradicts the code-reading, the executed evidence wins; if the pipeline did not reproduce 08/06/2026, say NOT-REPRODUCED and explain rather than forcing a verdict. Final message <=15 lines.
tasks.check: grep -qE 'VERDICT: (PHRASE-PICKING|VOCABULARY|BOTH|NOT-REPRODUCED)' report.md || { echo 'FAIL: no VERDICT line in report.md'; exit 1; }; grep -q 'PIPELINE_RESOLVED=' report.md || { echo 'FAIL: evidence must quote the PIPELINE_RESOLVED line'; exit 1; }; grep -q 'STAGE2(' report.md || { echo 'FAIL: evidence must quote a STAGE2 line'; exit 1; }; python3 -c "import json; c=json.load(open('eval_cases.json')); assert isinstance(c,list) and len(c)>=10, 'only %d cases, need 10' % len(c); assert any(x.get('expected')=='08/13/2026' and x.get('context')=='correction-after-offer' for x in c), 'incident case (expected 08/13/2026, correction-after-offer) missing'; print('eval_cases.json: %d cases, incident present' % len(c))" || exit 1; echo 'PASS: report grounded in executed repro; corpus extension valid'
tasks.verified: A verdict on where the following-Thursday defect lives (phrase-picking vs resolver vocabulary), grounded in the executed reproduction lines, with the minimal fix named at file:line and a 10+ case eval-corpus extension including the incident itself.
